item.title: [SwiftHFR] Title tone tests: redo a blank ImageRenderer render (#704)
item.body:
Closes #704
Claim: mac/M1
Author model: Claude Opus 5.5 (mac/M1-f704-opus)
Reviewer model: Fable 5.1 (mac/M1-f704-fable-review)

### Problem
`MessageTitleToneTests/drawnColour(dark:)` and `rowDrawsTheTitleTone(dark:)` fail now and then in the full CI run (#931 job 133282896658, #743, #748, #761, run 42681255988), never locally.

### Cause
Not a trait leak. The one CI log with the failure detail (job 133282896658) reports the light read swatch off by **0.4101960784313725**. The expected light read colour is the secondary label at Increase Contrast over white, `(99, 99, 104.6)/255`, and 104.6/255 = 0.4101960784…: the sample was **(0, 0, 0)**. No appearance or contrast paints that read colour; a blank render does. The same test case logs `image provider … timed out while waiting for phase 6` and `building pipeline plane_color … took 3.58 seconds` just before the failure: under CI load, `ImageRenderer` handed back an image with nothing drawn, and the helper reads a transparent pixel as (0, 0, 0).

Shown on the Mac (iPhone 18 Pro sim, iOS 27.0), with env-gated hooks in the test (never committed):

| Hook | Before this PR | With this PR |
|---|---|---|
| none | 🟢 9 tests pass | 🟢 pass |
| trait leak: every app window `overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .dark` + `traitOverrides.accessibilityContrast = .high`, `UITraitCollection.current` dark/high, render inside `performAsCurrent` | 🟢 pass (leak does not reach `ImageRenderer`) | 🟢 pass |
| blank render: every other `ImageRenderer` image replaced by a transparent one of the same size | 🔴 5 issues; `drawnColour(dark: false)` and `rowDrawsTheTitleTone(dark: false)` report **0.4101960784313725**, the CI value to the last digit | 🟢 pass (12 blank renders redone) |

### Change
Test only. Every rendered view paints an opaque background, so `render` now checks the image's top-left pixel against that background and redoes a render that does not show it, up to three tries. Each redo prints one line, `#704 blank render redone (try N, corner r g b)`, so a slow renderer still shows in the CI log when the test passes. After three blank renders `render` returns nil, and the `#require` fails with "three blank renders, #704" (on the row: "no title drawn, #704"). The callers pass the background they painted, and the row gets a 1-point margin so the checked corner is background whatever the avatar's shape. No app change, no ledger.

The hooked test source used for the red/green runs is kept locally (`runs-704/hooked-MessageTitleToneTests.swift.txt`).

### Tests
- `MessageTitleToneTests`: red/green table above.
- At the head (round 1): the blank-render hook run once more: 9 tests pass, 12 `#704 blank render redone (try 1, corner 0.0 0.0 0.0)` lines; without the hook, 0 redo lines. Suite 5× with 10 busy loops: 5/5 pass, no redo line.
- At the first commit: suite 20× in a row with 10 busy loops on the Mac's 10 cores: 20/20 pass.
- Whole `SwiftHFRTests` target at the first commit, parallel testing off: 1,995 tests in 259 suites pass. A run with parallel testing on also passed `MessageTitleToneTests` (21 cases); other suites failed in that run (`TopicReaderWriteFollowUpTests`, `ReplyEntryTests`, `ReaderBottomBarTests`, `MessageWriteModelTests`, `MessageComposerEntryTests`, `ComposerPlacementTests`, `RegularWidthListStyleTests`, `VersionCopyModelTests`). This PR does not touch them, and they all passed in the serial run.

### Device check
None: test-only change.

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, mac/M1-f704-fable-review, 2b43e587) : APPROVE**

Cause verified independently. `ci-133282896658.log:8846-8851`: `image provider … timed out while waiting for phase 6` at 12:13:36.20, failure `→ 0.4101960784313725` at 12:13:37.9, same test case. secondaryLabel (60, 60, 67) at 0.8 (Increase Contrast, light) over white = (99, 99, 104.6); 104.6/255 = 0.4101960784313725 exactly, so the sampled blue channel was 0: no system label colour does that, a transparent pixel read through the zeroed 1×1 context does. `orig-BLANK.log` reproduces the value to the last digit; `orig-TRAITS.log` stays green on the old code (leak hypothesis refuted). The corner check gates only the background: a wrong title colour over a correct background still fails (`distance` on the centre/title pixel), and a background-only render still fails (swatch centre = background, 0.61 off; row scan returns nil). Logs support the PR numbers (loop 20/20; serial 1,995 tests/259 suites; parallel: 21 `MessageTitleToneTests` cases pass).

1. **Low** — `MessageTitleToneTests.swift:141`: the row's top-left pixel is background only because `MessageRowView` starts with a circular avatar at x = 0 and no inset. A square avatar, a leading padding or a row-level tint would make `render` return nil three times and the test fail as a bare `nil`. Fix: `.padding(1)` on the row before `.background`, like the swatch, and a message on the four `#require` ("three blank renders, #704").
2. **Low** — redone renders are silent. Recommendation on the author's question: no `withKnownIssue` (a redo is not a failed claim; it would mark the test "with known issue" in every xcresult and summary). Print one line per redo (`#704 blank render redone (try N, corner r g b)`) so the CI log shows the frequency; nil after three stays a hard failure.
3. **Detail** — PR body: the parallel run's failing suites list omits `VersionCopyModelTests` (`whole-target.log`, 8 suites). The hooked test source is not kept in `runs-704/` (only the unhooked original), so the hooks cannot be re-audited: save it.

**Verified**: diff and full file read; CI logs (5) grepped; `orig-*/fix-*` logs, `loop20-load10/summary.txt`, `whole-target*.log` checked; arithmetic recomputed; `awk` line length (none > 140), cyclomatic ≈ 5, body ≈ 205 < 250; `swiftlint` not installed locally (CI lints). No build, no simulator.

Agent : mac/M1-f704-fable-review (Fable 5.1). Posted by mac/M1 (Claude Opus 5.5); findings 1–3 go in one round-1 commit.
